title: 9 Best Herbal Creams For Psoriasis
intro: Herbal creams for Psoriasis are topical treatments made from natural herbs and plants that have anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties, used to soothe and calm the skin affected by psoriasis. The benefits of using herbal creams for psoriasis include reduced inflammation, improved skin texture, and a decrease in the appearance of symptoms such as redness and scaling. Examples of herbal creams used to treat psoriasis include creams infused with Aloe Vera, which helps to calm and moisturize the skin, Turmeric, which has anti-inflammatory properties, Tea Tree Oil, which has antiseptic properties to reduce the risk of infection, Chamomile, which has anti-inflammatory and soothing properties, and Capsicum, which helps to reduce pain and inflammation. Additionally, other herbal creams such as Calendula, Ginkgo Biloba, and Rosehip oil are also used to treat psoriasis due to their ability to promote skin regeneration, reduce inflammation, and improve skin elasticity.

preparations.preparation_desc: Aloe barbadensis creams have been widely used to treat the psoriasis ailment due to their anti-inflammatory and moisturizing properties, which help to soothe and calm the affected skin. The herbal preparation contains bioactive constituents such as aloin, aloe-emodin, and vitamins A, C, and E, which have been shown to reduce inflammation, promote wound healing, and protect the skin from further irritation. By applying Aloe barbadensis creams to the affected areas, individuals with psoriasis can experience relief from symptoms such as redness, itching, and flaking, leading to improved skin health and quality of life. The benefits of using Aloe barbadensis creams to treat psoriasis include reduced inflammation, improved skin hydration, and enhanced wound healing, making it a popular natural remedy for this chronic condition.
preparations.preparation_study: According to Tropical medicine & international health : TM & IH, Aloe barbadensis creams for psoriasis showed a significant efficacy in curing patients with psoriasis vulgaris, with a cure rate of 83.3% compared to 6.6% for the placebo group.

preparations.preparation_desc: Calendula officinalis creams have been used for centuries to treat various skin conditions, including psoriasis, due to their anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and soothing properties. The bioactive constituents present in Calendula officinalis, such as triterpenoid saponins and flavonoids, help to reduce inflammation and promote wound healing, which are beneficial in treating psoriasis. By applying Calendula officinalis creams to the affected areas, individuals can experience relief from symptoms such as redness, itching, and scaling associated with psoriasis. The benefits of using Calendula officinalis creams to treat psoriasis include reduced inflammation, improved skin hydration, and accelerated wound healing, making it a popular natural remedy for this chronic condition.
preparations.preparation_study: According to "Phytomedicine : international journal of phytotherapy and phytopharmacology", Calendula officinalis creams for psoriasis may exhibit anti-inflammatory effects and promote wound healing, as it was found to have beneficial effects when combined with other herbs in a three-herbs formula, including reducing inflammation and promoting cell migration in vitro.

preparations.preparation_desc: Urtica dioica creams, derived from the leaves of the plant, have been widely used to treat psoriasis, a chronic skin condition characterized by inflammation and scaly patches. The anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and immunomodulatory properties of Urtica dioica creams help to reduce inflammation, soothe the skin, and promote healing. The bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, in Urtica dioica creams have been shown to inhibit the production of pro-inflammatory cytokines and reduce the severity of psoriasis symptoms. By reducing inflammation and promoting skin health, Urtica dioica creams offer a natural and effective treatment option for psoriasis, alleviating symptoms such as itching, redness, and scaling.
preparations.preparation_study: According to the study, Urtica dioica creams for psoriasis may have the potential to greatly improve the quality of life of the patient, indicating a possible therapeutic effect in the treatment of plaque psoriasis.

preparations.preparation_desc: Hypericum perforatum creams, also known as St. John's Wort creams, have been traditionally used to treat psoriasis due to their anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and immunomodulatory properties. The bioactive constituents of Hypericum perforatum, including hyperforin and hypericin, have been found to help reduce inflammation and promote skin regeneration, thereby alleviating the symptoms of psoriasis. The creams help to soothe and calm the skin, reducing redness and itching associated with psoriasis, and promoting a healthy skin environment. The benefits of using Hypericum perforatum creams for treating psoriasis include reduced symptoms, improved skin health, and a natural, non-invasive treatment option that avoids the side effects of conventional medications.
preparations.preparation_study: According to the study, Hypericum perforatum creams for psoriasis are among the next candidates suggested by present evidence, along with Mahonia and Capsicum (capsaicin), after some plant-derived substances like dithranol and methoxsalen (8-methoxypsoralen) have already been accepted as standard treatments.

preparations.preparation_desc: Avena sativa creams have been used to treat the psoriasis ailment due to their anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and soothing properties that help to calm and reduce inflammation on the affected skin. The avenanthramides present in Avena sativa creams have been found to inhibit the production of pro-inflammatory cytokines, thus reducing the inflammation and scaling associated with psoriasis. The benefits of using Avena sativa creams to treat psoriasis include reduced redness and inflammation, improved skin texture, and a decrease in the severity of symptoms, making it a popular natural remedy for managing this chronic condition.
